executive_summary: The infrastructure has a low risk posture with no immediate threats. Main concerns are the lack of detailed server specifications and potential single points of failure in network devices.

predicted_failures.description: The network device lacks redundancy, increasing the risk of service disruption if it fails.

root_causes.description: The network device does not have a redundant backup, leading to potential service outages.

preventive_measures.action: Implement active-active high availability for the network device.
preventive_measures.rationale: Ensuring redundancy will prevent service outages due to single points of failure.
